verdict.rationale: Fireflies has an AI assistant (AskFred), so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for this product. However, every MCP item in the evidence describes Fireflies as an MCP server that other AI tools connect to, such as ChatGPT and AI coding tools. Nothing shows users can plug external MCP servers into Fireflies or AskFred so it can call their tools. Server-side evidence does not transfer to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
